working_definition: Pm3 is a proximal medullary amacrine interneuron of the adult Drosophila optic lobe. It branches at the proximal surface of the medulla, arborising in layer M9 with broad, intermingling arbors at a peripheral intracolumnar position. It is GABAergic and there are approximately 35-40 cells per hemisphere.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Proximal medullary amacrine neuron that branches at the proximal surface of the medulla, with both branches forming a broad terminal arbor in medulla layer M9. The processes of different cells intermingle significantly, and the arbor density is heterogeneous. It occupies a peripheral intracolumnar position. It is GABAergic (Davis et al., 2020). There are around 35-40 of these cells per hemisphere (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: The FBbt term 'proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm3' (FBbt:00110066) matches the cluster on every dimension: same name (Pm3), same neuropil location (proximal surface of medulla, layer M9), same morphology (broad terminal arbor, intermingling processes, peripheral intracolumnar position), same neurotransmitter (GABAergic), and consistent cell count (~35-40 per hemisphere). The term is not obsolete and has no sub-subtypes in FBbt that would require a more specific assignment. The cluster label in the atlas is the canonical anatomical name, making this an exact match.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm2 (Erclik et al., 2017). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth temporal window (Erclik et al., 2017).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: This term describes the immature (larval/pupal) precursor form of Pm3, not the adult neuron. The Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas is an adult fly optic-lobe dataset, so the mature adult term is the correct match.

recommendation: Assign FBbt:00110066 (proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm3) as an exact match. No new term is needed and no curator verification is required beyond routine review.
